newsitem.title: USA: MCI details local telephone service plans.
newsitem.headline: MCI details local telephone service plans.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp on Tuesday named the 13 additional cities in which it will be offering switched local telephone service by March 1997, as part of its 25-city MCI Metro network.
It already has networks up and running in twelve cities, and by the end of this year says it will have invested $1 billion in total in its local services initiative.
It said expects to invest a like amount in 1997 if the competitive environment is favourable.
The new cities are Denver, Los Angeles, Memphis, Miami, Minneapolis, Newark, Orlando, Phoenix, Portland, Raleigh, San Diego, San Francisco and Tampa.
Its circuits are already operational in Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Detroit, Hartford, Milwaukee, New York, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh and Seattle.

By owning its own networks and switches rather than relying on reselling the services of regional Bells, MCI plans to be able to offer the advanced services to businesses which have the highest profit margins.
